dedupe_keys.name: approved zoning classification maps of bahrain by governorate urban planning and development authority

description: The Urban Planning and Development Authority of Bahrain, created by royal decree in 2017, publishes the approved zoning classification maps that set permitted land uses for each governorate. The Muharraq Governorate page read on 2026-09-28 offers a 4-page PDF of the governorate's classification maps (22.78 MB, uploaded in 2019) and six map sheets coded AZ-5101-00 to AZ-5106-00 as image files, two of them replaced in 2022 and 2025; the site holds similar pages for the other governorates, links to the national strategic structure plan map and the Tachteet planning platform, and has an open data page. Coverage is the Kingdom of Bahrain by governorate. Access is free download; the licence is not stated on the page and the site's copyright policy was not read. Caveats: maps are raster images or PDFs without GIS attributes, sheets are updated one by one, and the Arabic legend must be read for the zoning codes. It supports land-use context for hazard exposure and capacity planning studies in Bahrain, such as coastal flood exposure of residential and industrial zones on Muharraq. Related record: data-bahrain-bsdi-national-gis holds the national GIS base layers that complement these maps.
